articles.title: Ballon d'Or 2026: Lionel Messi, Yamal and Mbappe among favourites; how the winners are decided
articles.summary: The Ballon d'Or winners will be announced on Monday, with a new generation of football stars, led by Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé, hoping to win the
articles.body: The Ballon d'Or winners will be announced on Monday, with a new generation of football stars, led by Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé, hoping to win the award that was dominated for years by Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo.At 39, Messi still remains in contention for football's biggest individual honour after his performances at the World Cup. While the focus is increasingly shifting towards a potential Yamal-Mbappé rivalry, Harry Kane's remarkable goalscoring form could delay the start of a new era by another year.The women's award will have a new winner after Barcelona and Spain midfielder Aitana Bonmati, who claimed the honour for the past three years, missed out on the shortlist following a leg fracture in December.Two-time winner Alexia Putellas is the favourite to claim the award for the third time.Here's everything you need to know about the Ballon d'Or, which translates from French as Golden Ball.Where and when is the Ballon d'Or ceremony?The ceremony will take place at the London Palladium on Monday at 2000 GMT (1:30am IST). It is the first time the annual event has been held outside France since 2015 and the first time it will be staged in London.This year marks the 70th anniversary of the awards, which were introduced by French magazine France Football in 1956. The women's Ballon d'Or was established in 2018.The favourites to win the Ballon d'OrFour players have emerged as the leading contenders from the 30-man shortlist for the men's award: Yamal, Mbappé, Kane and Messi. They are competing for the trophy won by Ousmane Dembélé last year.Yamal, who was named the best young player in each of the past two years, is well placed to win his first Ballon d'Or after helping Spain win the World Cup and Barcelona claim the Spanish title.Mbappé, meanwhile, was expected to establish himself as the world's best player long before now. He won the World Cup with France in 2018 at the age of 19, but his position in the Ballon d'Or rankings has slipped in recent years. He finished seventh last year.The French forward had an outstanding individual season last term and also became the highest scorer in World Cup history. However, his inability to lead Real Madrid or France to trophies could count against him in the voting.Kane's case is different. The England captain has broken goalscoring records in Germany while winning titles with Bayern Munich. He was also among the leading performers at the World Cup, where England finished third.Messi refuses to leave the conversationMany expected Messi to fade from the Ballon d'Or race after moving to Major League Soccer (MLS) to play for Inter Miami. However, the Argentine, widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time, has continued to make his presence felt.He guided Miami to their first MLS Cup last season before producing another impressive World Cup campaign with Argentina. Messi helped his country come within one win of securing back-to-back World Cup titles.Argentina eventually lost the final to Spain, but Messi once again played a major role in the tournament.Putellas favourite to reclaim the women's awardPutellas is the favourite to win the women's Ballon d'Or after returning to her best form and helping Barcelona win the Champions League and Spanish title before joining London City Lionesses.The Spain international suffered ligament damage in the past, during which time Bonmati rose to become the leading name in women's football. Putellas now has the chance to return to the top by winning the award for a third time, although Bonmati's absence due to injury means she will not face the three-time defending champion.Other leading contenders include Manchester City forward Khadija Shaw and Barcelona's Claudia Pina.How is the Ballon d'Or decided?The Ballon d'Or winner is determined by a vote, with one journalist from each of the top 100 nations in the FIFA rankings taking part.The criteria include individual and team performances, “decisive and impressive character” and “class and fair play.”Each journalist selects 10 players from the 30 nominees and ranks them in order. The first choice receives 15 points, while the 10th receives one point. The player with the highest total wins the Ballon d'Or.If players finish level on points, the winner is decided by the number of first-place votes. If the tie remains, second-place votes are considered, followed by the subsequent positions.Kane's recent form will not count towards the awardKane has continued to score at an impressive rate, with records falling along the way.Last month, he became the fastest player to score 100 Bundesliga goals, reaching the milestone in just 98 appearances.His form at the start of the season has strengthened his case for the Ballon d'Or. However, there is one important limitation: the voting period ended after the World Cup. The official period ran from August 3, 2025, to July 19, 2026.Kane's performances and trophies during that period have already made him a serious contender. Had the opening weeks of the current campaign also been included, his case for being named the world's best player would have been even stronger.Players with the most Ballon d'Or winsMessi holds the record with eight Ballon d'Or titles, the most recent of which came in 2023. Ronaldo is second with five wins, having last claimed the award in 2017.Michel Platini, Johan Cruyff and Marco van Basten have won the trophy three times each.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Los arranques 'diésel' de Aguirre: cuesta ganar y en el Valencia se repite
articles.standfirst: Misma esencia que con Zaragoza, Leganés y Espanyol mientras que el primer triunfo rápido llegó con el Mallorca, en su segundo duelo... pero ha sabido enderezarlo con el tiempo
articles.summary: Misma esencia que con Zaragoza, Leganés y Espanyol mientras que el primer triunfo rápido llegó con el Mallorca, en su segundo duelo... pero ha sabido enderezarlo con el tiempo
articles.body: Javier Aguirre ha tenido que actuar de entrenador bombero o revulsivo en varias ocasiones en la Liga española. Le ha pasado con una retahíla de equipos. Con el Zaragoza, el Espanyol, el Leganés, el Mallorca y ahora con el Valencia y lo cierto es que llegar a mitad de temporada para reflotar las naves no ha sido tarea sencilla. Porque hay un detalle llamativo que impera en la mayoría de situaciones que ha vivido con sus equipos. Cuesta romper el hielo. Cuesta ganar. Para empezar, con el Valencia lleva tres partidos en los que aún no ha podido hacerse con esa victoria balsámica que cambie el ambiente dentro y fuera del equipo. Porque ha empatado ante el Racing de Santander (2-2) y el Athletic de Bilbao (0-0), pero en su tercer encuentro se quedó con la miel en los labios y perdió en el descuento con el Villarreal (1-2). Por el momento la victoria se le resiste. Esto no hace más que confirmar los arranques 'diésel' que tiene cuando entra en un equipo por emergencias, léase empezada la campaña. Le ha pasado con Zaragoza, Leganés, Mallorca y Espanyol. Fue en la campaña 2010-11. Cogió a un equipo en crisis. Y el triunfo tardó en llegar. 1-1 contra Getafe, derrota ante el Villarreal (0-3), empate ante el Almería (1-1), derrota ante el Real Madrid (1-3), empate ante Osasuna (0-0) y por fin victoria ante la Real Sociedad (2-1). Otro inicio complicado. El partido de Copa lo perdió ante el Sevilla, y luego en Liga se sucedieron estos resultados iniciales: ante el Granada (0-0), ante el Sevilla (2-2), ante el Real Madrid (2-2) y ganó al Dépor (2-0) a la cuarta. Con el Leganés tampoco resultó ser sencillo el comienzo. 1-1 ante la Real Sociedad, derrota (1-2) ante el Barcelona, derrota (1-0) ante el Sevilla y gana al Celta (3-2). Tal vez con el Mallorca haya sido un revulsivo con todas las de la ley. Porque es el equipo con el que ganó más rápido. También es cierto que era 'a vida o muerte'. Perdió su primer partido ante el Getafe (1-0) y ganó al segundo (1-0) al Atlético de Madrid.

articles.title: From 12,000 players assessed to 14 selected for Azerbaijan, how India are building a scouting network to find their next generation of football talent
articles.summary: India's search for the next generation of football talent has taken a step forward, with the country's U-15 team continuing its winning run at the
articles.body: India's search for the next generation of football talent has taken a step forward, with the country's U-15 team continuing its winning run at the inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival Azerbaijan 2026. The Blue Colts beat Cameroon 2-1 in their second Group K match in Baku on Sunday, but the result is also part of a much bigger effort to identify and develop young footballers across the country.Over the past two years, the All India Football Federation (AIFF) has assessed more than 12,000 players from across India as it looks to identify promising talent and prepare them for the future. The initiative was originally designed to find players born in 2011 and 2012 and develop them through AIFF-FIFA talent academies. The launch of the FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival has given that effort a wider purpose.India have selected 14 players for the tournament in Azerbaijan, but the programme extends well beyond the squad. Many other young footballers have been tracked as part of an effort to build a pipeline of talent for Indian football.The team made a strong start against Cameroon on Sunday. Deepak Singh Arambam's corner in the first minute caused confusion inside the opposition box, with Fareil Ngobo attempting a headed clearance that sent the ball into his own net to give India the lead.Cameroon drew level through an own goal by Muhammad Sohil Khan in the 20th minute at the Hovsan Competition Complex Pitch 1B. India regained the lead in the 27th minute through R Lalremruatfela, while goalkeeper Jenit Ningthoujam made several saves, including stopping a penalty, to help secure the victory.India are now the only team in Group K to have won both their matches so far. Despite the rainy conditions, they managed the closing stages well, held their shape and saw out the game for a second successive win.India will face Grenada later on Sunday before concluding the qualification stage against Bahrain and Senegal on October 26. Their results across the five matches will determine which performance tier they enter in the second phase.Behind this team is a scouting operation led by Bibiano Fernandes, a former India international who earned one cap for the senior national team. Now 49, Fernandes has moved into coaching and is in charge of India's U-15 side.Finding the right players in a country of 1.4 billion people is a task no single coach can manage alone. The AIFF has built a network of 60 talent scouts across different states and regions, who monitor more than 20 football competitions and leagues to identify young players with potential.“These scouts cover youth and school competitions, as well as private tournaments involving academies. They identify talented players, particularly in the U-14 and U-15 age groups, and add them to our database. When they spot someone with real promise, they keep tracking their progress,” Fernandes told Inside FIFA.The process does not end when a player catches a scout's attention. Those identified are assessed over time before a smaller group is invited to camps and trials. Players from Indian Super League club academies also participate, allowing the coaching staff to compare youngsters who have developed in different football environments.This work has helped the coaching staff select the 14 players representing India at the FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival. Their choices were based on more than technical ability, with discipline and the willingness to give their best on the pitch also considered.“Discipline was one of the most important criteria. We were looking for players who would give their all on the pitch. We also assessed their footballing qualities, including their technique, communication and understanding of the game,” said Fernandes.For the 14 players in Azerbaijan, the tournament is an opportunity to test themselves against young footballers from other countries. For the coaching staff, it is also a chance to assess how this generation compares with its international peers and identify the areas in which the players need to improve.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Diomande se consagra en su primer Clásico y pone en un aprieto a Vinicius
articles.standfirst: El jugador de Costa de Marfil hace olvidar al brasileño y se gana su sitio en el tridente
articles.summary: El jugador de Costa de Marfil hace olvidar al brasileño y se gana su sitio en el tridente
articles.body: El Real Madrid sale muy reforzado del Clásico. Mourinho, el primero, y en el campo puede que quien haya salido del Camp Nou por la puerta grande es Yan Diomande. Su fichaje no estuvo exento de ruido, sobre todo por sus 140 millones, y porque le costó arrancar. Diez partidos de Liga después y sobre todo un partido de esta talla confirman que el esfuerzo por este fichaje tenía su lógica. Lo cierto es que el ex jugador ya venía avisando desde que Mou le dio la titularidad ante el Rayo. Repitió ante el Elche y con nota, pero no le bastó para ser titular en el derbi. Sin embargo, regresó al once ante el Villarreal, con gol, y ya no se cayó más. De nuevo ante el Sevilla y otro tanto, un golazo ante el Leipzig en Champions, aunque fue suplente por Vinicius, y notable ante el Barça. Fue una pesadilla constante en ataque y un defensor más en su propio campo. Incansable, como en la remontada en Roma. Fue en Italia donde mandó el primer aviso serio. Primero por la derecha, para asistir a Kylian, pero en la segunda fue un puñal por la izquierda tras quitar Mou a Vini muy pronto (minuto 59 para dar entrada a Espí) en busca de revulsivos y ocupar el costamarfileño ese costado. La baja de cuatro partidos de Vinicius le han dejado además vía libre por el costado izquierdo, donde parece que más cómodo se encuentra el costamarfileño. Un gran fichaje para Mou, pero un debate a la vista, porque ahora mismo es un jugador capital en el tridente de ataque, no solo por lo que ofrece hacia arriba, sino porque es un lujo para el entrenador por lo que aporta defensivamente. Habrá que esperar al regreso de Vinicius para conocer el movimiento de Mourinho. Ayer formó con Mbappé y Güler, que hasta ahora había jugado más atrás. No ha podido estrenarse mejor Diomande en un Clásico. Un caño a Lamine, una jugada polémica por una entrada de Cancelo que pudo dejar al Barça con diez, primordial en el primer gol de Kylian al ganar la línea de fondo. Estuvo en todos lados y Mou solo le quitó del campo para ganar tiempo, en el minuto 94 para que entrara Espí. "En vez de jugar con el 25, juega con el 125 de lo que se ha pagado", comentó Mou tras su buen partido ante el Sevilla. Lo cierto es que el jugador juega ya con menos presión que en el inicio. El Clásico ha sido el mejor ejemplo.
